title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Creighton University
description: A guide to the essential late-night food and supply runs for Creighton University students, featuring on-campus dining and local Omaha favorites open late.

cards.title: The Skutt Convenience Hub
cards.subtitle: Skutt Student Center
cards.notes: Grab snacks, toiletries, or a quick pizza at this on-campus market. It serves as a primary late-night resource for students in the Skutt Student Center.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus convenience store in the Skutt Student Center offering snacks and essentials until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack and Ed's Marketplace is open until 10 p.m. Monday through Thursday and on Sundays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10 p.m. Mon-Thu and Sun; closes at 7 p.m. Fri-Sat.

cards.title: Late-Night Dining at Skutt
cards.subtitle: Skutt Student Center
cards.notes: Visit the Skutt Student Center for a late-night meal. This retail dining area offers options like Qdoba and Firehouse Subs during designated late hours.
cards.short_summary: A retail dining hub on campus offering late-night food options for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Wareham Court offers late-night dining hours from 8 p.m. to 10 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Late-night hours are 8 p.m. to 10 p.m. Monday through Thursday.

cards.title: Finals Week Late Night Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Brandeis Building
cards.notes: Join the tradition of Late Night Breakfast during finals week. Faculty and staff serve breakfast foods to students to fuel their late-night study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A signature Creighton tradition where students gather for a late-night meal served by faculty during finals.
cards.evidence_claim: The Late Night Breakfast event at Brandeis Dining Hall runs from 10 p.m. to 11:30 p.m. during finals week.
cards.access_notes: Event typically occurs from 10 p.m. to 11:30 p.m. on the Monday of finals week.

cards.title: The Blackstone Cookie Run
cards.subtitle: Blackstone District
cards.notes: Head to the Blackstone District for warm cookies and ice cream. It is a popular late-night destination for students seeking a sweet treat after dark.
cards.short_summary: A late-night bakery in the Blackstone District serving warm cookies until 1 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: The Insomnia Cookies location in the Blackstone District is open until 1 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Open until 1 a.m. daily for pickup and delivery.

cards.title: 24-Hour Taco Stop
cards.subtitle: 44th and Dodge
cards.notes: Drive through for authentic Mexican food at any hour. This spot is a staple for students needing a substantial meal in the middle of the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Mexican restaurant with a drive-thru located near campus on Dodge Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Abelardo's Mexican Fresh drive-thru is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

cards.title: The Late-Night Chicken Run
cards.subtitle: 70th and Dodge
cards.notes: Drive out to Dodge Street for a Box Combo. This location stays open much later than others, making it a prime target for late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: A popular chicken finger restaurant on Dodge Street open until 2 a.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: The Raising Cane's on Dodge Street is open until 2 a.m. on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Omaha, NE - 7060 Dodge Street
cards.access_notes: Open until 2 a.m. Thu-Sat; until 12 a.m. Sun-Wed.

cards.title: Midtown Sandwich Stop
cards.subtitle: Farnam Midtown
cards.notes: Order a toasted sandwich or pizza in Midtown. It's a convenient stop for students in the Blackstone or Midtown area during late study nights.
cards.short_summary: A gourmet cafe in Midtown Omaha serving toasted sandwiches and pizza until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Pickleman's Gourmet Cafe in Farnam Midtown is open until 10 p.m. daily.

cards.title: The Turner Park Supply Run
cards.subtitle: 30th and Dodge
cards.notes: Pick up snacks, beverages, or health essentials near campus. This location is a reliable late-night resource for students living in nearby residence halls.
cards.short_summary: A pharmacy and convenience store near campus open until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: The Walgreens at 3001 Dodge St is open until 11 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: 3001 DODGE ST, Omaha, NE 68131 - Walgreens Pharmacy
cards.access_notes: Store and photo department open until 11 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Dodge Street Essentials
cards.subtitle: 48th and Dodge
cards.notes: Stop by for late-night groceries or pharmacy needs. Located along the ORBT line, it's easily accessible for students without cars.
cards.short_summary: A pharmacy and retail store on Dodge Street providing late-night access to essentials.
cards.evidence_claim: The CVS Pharmacy at 4840 Dodge St is open until 11 p.m. on Mondays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: CVS Pharmacy at 4840 Dodge St. Omaha, NE 68132
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 p.m. Mon and Sat; until 9 p.m. Tue-Fri; until 10 p.m. Sun.

cards.title: The Study Fuel Station
cards.subtitle: Skutt Student Center
cards.notes: Get a caffeine boost for late-night studying. This on-campus Starbucks is a central meeting point for students working in the student center.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus Starbucks location in the Skutt Student Center open until 7 p.m. on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: The Skutt Student Center Starbucks is open until 7 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 7 p.m. Mon-Thu; closes earlier on weekends.
